body.message:
Thanks for getting back to us Karolina. The studio at Palm Tower is available from this Monday, all-inclusive at AED 9,300 per month.

For stays of a few months, we lock in the current rate for the first 3 months. After that, rates depend on the season and we'd confirm with you closer to the time. Does that work for you, or would you like to know about other options?
